senses.gloss:
ITA-1.8.2.4 hetu हेतु
Cause or variable
A cause or reason; the immediate cause of an observable event; the pivotal element in the inferential process.

ITA-4.5.8 hetuviparītaḥ हेतुविपरीतः
Antagonistic to etiology
The judicious use of medicines, regimens and dietetics that are antagonistic to the etiology of the disease or condition.

ITA-9.1.57 hetuviparītacikitsā हेतुविपरीतचिकित्सा
Treatment antagonistic One of the threefold classifications of treatment antagonistic to to cause the cause.

ITA-4.5.12 hetuviparītārthakārī हेतुविपरीतार्थकारी
Treatment with interventions similar to disease etiology
The judicious use of medicines, regimens and dietetics that are similar to the etiology of the disease or condition, but capable of providing relief.

ITA-4.5.10 hetuvyādhiviparītaḥ हेतुव्याधिविपरीतः
Antagonistic to etiology and disease
The judicious use of medicines, regimens and dietetics that are antagonistic to both the etiology and disease itself.

ITA-4.5.14 hetuvyādhiviparītārthakārī हेतुव्याधिविपरीतार्थकारी
Treatment with interventions similar to disease etiology as well as diseaseaggravating factors
The judicious use of medicines, regimens and dietetics that are similar to both the etiology and disease, but capable of providing relief.

ITA-4.8.30 hetuvyādhiviparītārthakārī हेतुव्याधिविपरीतार्थकारी
Pro-causative factor and disease

ITA-1.7.29 hetvantaram हेत्वन्तरम्
Proposing the wrong reason
Proposing a fallacious or irrelevant form of reasoning in a given context.

ITA-1.6.36 hetvarthaḥ हेत्वर्थः
Extended reasoning
Extension or extrapolation of an argument or supportive reasoning from a different context.

ITA-1.8.2.8 hetvābhāsaḥ हेत्वाभासः
False positive or false negative
A fallacious inference which renders the entire inferential process invalid.
